info.name: Learning
info.summary: Self-hosted flashcards with FSRS scheduling, IT simulators, AI tutor & instructor analytics
info.description:
**Learning** is a self-hosted learning platform for Nextcloud. Your questions, progress, and student data never leave your server.
Built for IT certification bootcamps (CompTIA, Cisco, AWS) but works for any subject. Instructors create courses, track student progress, and identify at-risk learners. Students drill with scientifically-backed spaced repetition and hands-on simulations.
## Why Learning?
- **Your data stays on your server** — no cloud dependency, full GDPR compliance - **FSRS adaptive scheduling** — cards are prioritized by memory strength, not rigid intervals - **9 interactive IT simulators** — CLI terminals, firewall builders, DNS resolvers, subnet calculators, network topology placement - **AI tutor (optional)** — answers questions by citing your uploaded course materials - **Verifiable certificates** — issue cryptographically signed, publicly verifiable completion credentials
## For Instructors
- Course management with pool assignment and student enrollment - **At-risk warnings** — automatic detection of struggling students - **Chapter heatmaps** — see where the class struggles at a glance - **Curriculum timeline** — plan course schedule with milestones - **Admin dashboard** — CSV export, course archiving, cohort merging - Campaign selection — choose which story scenarios are available per course
## Certification & Compliance
- **Signed completion certificates** — every passing learner receives a cryptographically signed (Ed25519) certificate, minted automatically - **Public verification portal** — anyone can verify a certificate's authenticity via its permanent URL, no login required - **Compliance reports** — organization-wide completion overview for audits and works agreements - **Mandatory training & recertification** — assign required courses, track certificate expiry, and automate recertification reminders - **Tamper-proof audit trail** — every issuance, revocation, and completion is logged
## For Learners
- **Smart Queue** — one-click review of all due cards, sorted by urgency - **Training & Exam Mode** — practice or simulate timed exams - **PBQ Simulations** — performance-based questions with interactive CLI, drag-and-drop placement, and wiring tasks - **Story Campaigns** — learn through real IT incident scenarios (WannaCry, SolarWinds, Log4Shell) - **Live Duels & Sprint** — real-time multiplayer quiz battles via Server-Sent Events - **Gamification** — XP, levels, streaks, 10 badges, seasonal league - **Maintenance Mode** — long-term retention schedule after course ends - **Trouble-spot cheat sheet** — export your weakest topics for exam prep
## AI Features (optional)
Requires a Google Gemini API key. Without it, the app is fully functional — AI features are simply hidden. Each user must explicitly opt in before any data is sent to the API.
- **VirtuProf** — AI learning assistant with RAG-powered answers and source citations - **Question Generator** — create flashcards from pasted text - **Note Generator** — AI-powered topic summaries saved to Nextcloud Files
## Question Types
- Multiple Choice, Free Text with fuzzy matching, PBQ Simulations - CSV/JSON import & export, pool sharing, multi-language translations
## Technical
- Vue 3, Vite, Pinia — modern frontend stack - 1220 unit tests, PHPStan Level 5, pre-push quality gates - Native Nextcloud integration: Dashboard widgets, Notifications, Talk, Files - AGPL-3.0 — fully open source
## Requirements
- Nextcloud 33–35 - PHP 8.1+ - PostgreSQL 13+ or MySQL 8+
**Looking for pilot partners!** If you run Nextcloud at a school, university, or training provider — we'd love your feedback. Open an issue with a bit of context and we're happy to walk you through it.
